device_scope: Translate Linux VirtIO Block into the retained Asterinas block-device API: initialization and capacity, DMA request ownership, read/write completion, error status and flush as supported by the frozen QEMU features. Boot with the translated block driver and pass every function in the unchanged block_device.c, ext2/file_io.c and ext2/short_rw.c regression files.
